events.topic: Sudanese civil war / Abyei border conflict / Amiet market massacre
events.text: The death toll in the market drone attack in Abyei rises to 220.

events.topic: Sudanese civil war / Blue Nile campaign
events.text: The Sudanese Army says that they have repelled an attack by the Rapid Support Forces and Sudan People's Liberation Movement–North (SPLM–N) on the Blue Nile state.

events.topic: Sudanese civil war / War crimes in the Sudanese civil war
events.text: The Rapid Support Forces launches a drone strike on a power plant in Tendelti in Sudan's White Nile State, knocking out the main transition line connecting North Kordofan.
At least 14 people are killed and 20 others are injured after a bus and a truck collide head-on in Natore District, Bangladesh.
Twelve people are killed and 30 others are injured after a bus crashes into a truck near Cairo, Egypt.
Libya's eastern-based House of Representatives approves a 2019 maritime boundary agreement with Turkey and repeals two 2020 decisions that rejected the accord.
South Korea withdraws additional embassy staff from Ukraine following a dispute over two captured North Korean soldiers who were transferred to South Korea.
United Kingdom says it will deploy RAF Typhoons to help Saudis defend against Houthi attacks.

A United States federal judge sentences a Guatemalan national to 30 years in prison for helping organize a 2022 migrant-smuggling operation in San Antonio, Texas, that left 53 migrants dead and 11 injured.
The U.S. state of Florida executes William Reaves Jr. for the 1986 murder of Richard Raczkoski.

Malaysia's deregisters the opposition coalition Perikatan Nasional, citing internal disputes and breaches of the constitution, preventing its component parties from contesting forthcoming elections under a common coalition banner.

JAXA launches the Martian Moons eXploration spacecraft from the Tanegashima Space Center toward Phobos aboard an H3 rocket, aiming to collect at least 10 grams of surface material from the Martian moon and return the samples to Earth in 2031.
